name: Valentines Day
overview: Scripture reveals that love is a powerful and enduring force, exemplified by Jacob's devoted service for Rachel, motivated by deep affection. True love, as taught by Proverbs, covers sins and sustains friendship and family through adversity. Above all, Jesus commands believers to love God wholeheartedly and to extend that love to others, emphasizing that such love surpasses all religious offerings. This biblical understanding of love calls Christians to prioritize sincere, sacrificial love rooted in devotion to God and care for neighbors.
